layers.process: The park says park scouts and local guides are mandatory for all types of tourists. Visitors sign in themselves at the park office registration book, payment is by the day, fees paid are not refunded, and prices exclude turnover tax. The park gives the scout and guide rates on its Other Services Fees page, which was not readable as text, so no amounts are recorded here.

Foreign tourist rates, in Ethiopian birr (ETB): entrance 90 for 12 and over and 10 under 12; vehicle up to 12 seats 20 and over 12 seats 40; camping tent for up to four people 40 and for more than four 60. Foreign residents pay lower rates. No AUD conversion: no dated birr rate is held in the repo.
